fixtureContract.note: Field names, types, and units mirror a live 200 response recorded in cursor-usage-auth-probe.md Phase 6. All VALUES are synthetic and chosen to exercise the mapper, never a real account's figures. Money is minor units (cents). billingCycle* are epoch-millisecond strings, because proto3 JSON encodes 64-bit integers as strings. Percentages are precomputed and deliberately INCONSISTENT with spend over limit here, reproducing the live discrepancy so any attempt to derive them fails the tests.
